messages.content_text:
Been busy with starting classes again for school. 3/5 on trades this week. Unfortunately 2 of those wins were trades after an original L, so it was half risk and one of them got stopped out trailing. 

However I took this one today. Going into the day I was bullish, but wanted to see price fill the 1h FVG and hopefully tap midnight open. We got that and did get a nice 1m RB ET, but I didn't take it because I was leaving class lol and just saw it way too late. Then we ripped up and filled some 5m FVGs. I was still bullish because my HTF DOL was PDH. I wanted to limit midnight open but there wasn't any structure to support it, so I waited for a 1m ET in the form of a RB, entered and caught around 50 points. 

Overall not the best trade, but a win is a win, and I'm staying aggressive which for me is a good thing since I find myself overanalyzing and sitting out of good trades. Going to keep staying aggressive and find what works then remove the shitty trades. MOTTO ALL YEAR: shoot the damn ball.

messages.content_text: So today was not a very good day for me. I missed my fill on 3 potential winning trades today and so I tilted and took 2 low quality setups resulting in both of them being losses. Pretty mad at myself cause I’d been really good at staying unemotional and only taking high quality setups but I failed at that today. First trade was a continuation short after I missed my entry on the initial short down to London lows. Confluences on HTF were 1H,4H bearish FVG, and then 15min breaker and IFVG. Entry trigger was 1min FVG CE.
